fine_trace.code: unsigned int klass = buffer->idx < buffer->len ? machine.get_class (info[buffer->idx].codepoint, num_glyphs) : (unsigned) StateTable<EntryData>::CLASS_END_OF_TEXT;
fine_trace.note: When the state machine reaches end-of-text (buffer->idx == buffer->len) the driver does not stop: it selects CLASS_END_OF_TEXT and still dispatches the entry for that class, so the current-insert action runs with the index pointing past the last initialized glyph.

The current-insert path (entry->data.currentInsertIndex != 0xFFFF) with CurrentInsertBefore clear calls copy_glyph() without verifying that buffer->idx < buffer->len, so at end-of-text it copies a glyph from beyond the initialized buffer region.
copy_glyph() performs no bounds check against len and reads info[idx] with idx == len, copying uninitialized glyph info (including the codepoint) into the output buffer.
After the insertion subtable, swap_buffers() makes the output buffer (which contains the glyph copied from the uninitialized info[len]) the buffer consumed by the next morx subtable.
The next subtable's state machine reads info[idx].codepoint of the copied glyph and passes the uninitialized codepoint as the glyph id into the class table lookup.
The uninitialized codepoint is used as a glyph id in the lookup; the comparison is a branch on uninitialized data, producing the use-of-uninitialized-value.

via: CLASS_END_OF_TEXT entry dispatched at idx == len
copy_glyph() called without checking idx < len
uninitialized glyph info including codepoint written to out_info[out_len]
swap_buffers adopts output buffer as the buffer contents
next morx subtable reads info[idx].codepoint of copied glyph
classTable.get_value(glyph_id, num_glyphs) lookup keyed by uninitialized glyph id

vuln_logic.issue_alignment: The description states: the current-insert path in the shaping engine copies a glyph without ensuring the buffer index is valid, especially at end-of-text; this copies an uninitialized codepoint later used as a glyph id in a lookup. In AAT::InsertionSubtable::driver_context_t::transition (hb-aat-layout-morx-table.hh:648) the current-insert path calls buffer->copy_glyph() when CurrentInsertBefore is clear; at end-of-text the StateTableDriver (hb-aat-layout-common.hh:558) dispatches the end-of-text entry with buffer->idx == buffer->len, so copy_glyph() copies the uninitialized info[len] (hb-buffer.hh:251). The copied codepoint is then used as a glyph id in the class-table lookup of the next morx subtable (LookupFormat0::get_value, hb-aat-layout-common.hh:157), producing a use-of-uninitialized-value.
